newsitem.title: USA: U.S. GULF JET FUEL DIFFS FIRM IN ACTIVE TRADING.
newsitem.headline: U.S. GULF JET FUEL DIFFS FIRM IN ACTIVE TRADING.

text.p: U.S. Gulf spot jet fuel differentials firmed by late Thursday as buyers aggressively sought out prompt barrels.
On the NYMEX, the September heating oil futures shed 1.68 cents to settle at 55.30 cents a gallon.

U.S. Gulf prompt 54-grade jet fuel traded early in the day at 0.60 cent over the September futures before firming to 0.70 cent over later and peaking at 0.80 cent over. Buying by three large refiners helped boost the differential by about 0.15 cent on the day.
Prompt low sulphur 55-grade jet fuel was heard done at 0.80 cent over the September NYMEX, traders said.
Market watchers said no impact has been seen yet due to reduced jet demand from the UPS strike, since the 30,000 barrels a day was not enough to have an immediate effect.
"But if it goes on long enough we will," one trader said.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1620
